attachments.origin_landmark: alveolar processes of maxilla/mandible, pterygomandibular raphe
attachments.insertion_landmark: modiolus at the corner of the mouth

actions: compresses the cheek against the teeth (chewing, whistling, blowing)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Deepest of the cheek muscles, forming the muscular wall of the cheek; keeps food between the teeth during mastication.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
